sentences.text: The VDRRY scheme stands for the Vulnerability Reduction and Disaster Risk Reduction for Youth.
It aims to enhance the resilience of youth in disaster-prone areas.
The objectives include building capacity and awareness among youth regarding disaster risk reduction.
The scheme provides training and resources to empower youth to respond effectively to disasters.
Benefits include skill development in disaster management and access to resources for community engagement.
Eligibility criteria typically include age limits and residency in disaster-prone regions.
The application process involves registration through designated local government offices or online platforms.
The timeline for training programs may vary based on local implementation schedules.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in collaboration with local government bodies.
Additional details may include partnerships with NGOs for effective outreach and training.
